name: Eternal-Legacy-vita
description: Android to PS Vita port of Gameloft's Eternal Legacy
long_description: This port runs the compiled native Android library (`libEternalLegacy.so`, armeabi) directly on the PS Vita's ARM Cortex-A9 CPU, using a dynamic library loader (*soloader*) based on TheFloW's architecture, an Android runtime emulation layer (*FalsoJNI*), and vitaGL for OpenGL ES 2.0 graphics. The engine is Gameloft's *glitch* engine (derived from Irrlicht) with *gameswf* for the Flash UI and *Vox* for audio.
